comments.author: @TravelHorizon-4K
comments.text: Building tunnels through dangerous passes (like the Zoji La Tunnel in India) or replacing raw cliff tracks with paved highways saves lives, but it also strips away the legendary thrill and raw identity of these historic routes. Should safety and modern infrastructure always take absolute priority, or is there value in preserving some rugged, dangerous roads for extreme tourism and heritage?
